usage.outputShape: body is a base64-encoded MP4 video with a literal 'base64:' prefix (e.g. 'base64:AAAAIGZ0eXBpc29t...'); Content-Type: video/mp4
quirks: Input is a GET request with ?url= query param — there is no JSON body and no inputSchema; the url parameter is required but undocumented
Response body has a literal 'base64:' prefix before the base64 data — strip 'base64:' before decoding
The /animate endpoint returns an MP4 video (Content-Type: video/mp4), NOT a GIF as some docs suggest — decode/save as .mp4
Sibling /take endpoint returns a base64-prefixed JPEG (image/jpeg) at the same $0.02 price for a static screenshot
usage.guide: Make a GET request to https://screenshotone.x402.paysponge.com/animate with the target page URL as the ?url= query parameter (e.g. ?url=https://example.com). The x402 payment of $0.02 USDC on Base is handled automatically; no API key is required. The response body is a base64-encoded MP4 video prefixed with the literal string 'base64:' — strip that prefix, then base64-decode and save as a .mp4 file. For a static screenshot instead, use the /take endpoint (same param, returns a base64-prefixed JPEG).
